social_circle.name: Lauren Simmons

background.how_they_met: They met as young adults in the Richmond/Henrico area through overlapping community and mutual-friend circles before marrying.
background.why_close: Lauren is Baljinder's primary emotional support, co-parent, household partner, and the person who notices when work stress is weighing on him.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear, practical full sentences, often with gentle check-ins, calendar reminders, kid updates, and the occasional dry joke. Uses emojis lightly, mostly hearts or a weary smile.

shared_activities: Coordinating school schedules and children's activities
Discussing school board and county issues
Tea or check-ins after the children sleep
recent_text_topics: Coordinating Nikhil's robotics, soccer, and Maya's dance or art club around Baljinder's afternoon shifts.
Checking in after late or emotionally heavy dispatch shifts without asking for confidential details.
Budget timing around dental costs, car maintenance, groceries, and paying down the credit card balance.
Protecting Monday dinner and finding small windows to talk after the kids are asleep.
School stress, school discipline concerns, and local election or school board issues.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Baljinder is married to Lauren, an elementary school counselor, and that she knows when he is quiet because he is carrying work strain. Q44 says Lauren came out to the driveway during a rough week and sat with him. Q49 says he texts Lauren directly when struggling.

social_circle.name: Anita Patel

demographics.occupation: Project coordinator for a health care administration office

background.how_they_met: Anita is Baljinder's younger sister; they grew up together in Henrico County in a Punjabi Sikh and Goan Catholic immigrant household.
background.why_close: They share family history, parent-care responsibilities, cultural memory, humor, and regular contact through their children and nearby households.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts quickly and directly, often in short bursts. She teases Baljinder about overplanning, uses sarcasm comfortably, and is more likely than him to call something out plainly.

shared_activities: Coordinating care for Harjit and Teresa
Cousin visits almost every other weekend
Discussing race, policing, and family issues
Sharing parent medical forms or appointment details
recent_text_topics: Coordinating their mother's diabetes appointments and their father's blood pressure reminders.
Planning weekend cousin visits between Anita's children and Baljinder's children.
Teasing Baljinder when he turns family plans into spreadsheets.
Discussing race and policing after news stories or school-related conversations.
Splitting logistics for holidays, food, and parent transportation.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 identifies Anita as Baljinder's sister and describes their relationship as warm and teasing. Q35 says Baljinder and his sister share coordination of their parents' care. Q29 says he talks with his sister about race and policing.

social_circle.name: Teresa Simmons

demographics.education: High school plus vocational medical office training

background.how_they_met: Teresa is Baljinder's mother. She immigrated to the United States in the 1980s and raised him in Henrico County with Goan Catholic traditions.
background.why_close: They are close through family caregiving, food traditions, cultural rituals, and Teresa's ongoing role helping with the children.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts warmly but sometimes prefers phone calls. Her messages often include food questions, reminders, prayerful language, and practical health updates. She may mix English with familiar family phrases.

shared_activities: Christmas Mass and Catholic family gatherings
Cooking and adapting meals for diabetes
recent_text_topics: Asking whether Baljinder and the kids have eaten properly and offering to send food home.
Coordinating occasional overnight help with Nikhil and Maya.
Discussing her diabetes-friendly meals, knee pain, and appointment logistics.
Planning Christmas, Easter, or family food traditions with the Goan side of the family.
Checking on Baljinder after late shifts without pressing him for work details.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Baljinder's mother lives about twenty minutes away and still sends food home. Q13 says she may stay one night to help with the kids every couple of months. Q35 says Teresa has type 2 diabetes and knee pain and Baljinder helps with appointments or medical instructions.

social_circle.name: Calvin Brooks

demographics.education: Some college and public safety communications certifications

background.how_they_met: They met at the Henrico County Public Safety Communications Center when Baljinder was a newer dispatcher.
background.why_close: Calvin helped Baljinder through a major early-career crisis after a traumatic child medical call and became one of the few people who understands his dispatch stress without lengthy explanation.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts briefly and practically, often with gallows-humor restraint, check-ins after difficult shifts, and no wasted words. Rarely uses emojis.

shared_activities: Discussing dispatcher wellness and peer support
recent_text_topics: Checking on Baljinder after difficult overdose or crash-related calls.
Talking through whether to accept or decline overtime when Baljinder is near the edge.
Sharing thoughts about building a real dispatcher peer-support program.
Brief personal updates about family, sleep, and work stress after shifts.
Running jokes about dispatchers surviving on bad coffee and checklists.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q02 says Baljinder talked to an older dispatcher named Calvin after a traumatic child medical call and that Calvin told him the calls stay unless you build habits and talk to people who understand. Q05 says if stress is about work, Baljinder may text Calvin or another dispatcher. Q44 says he told Denise and Calvin during a rough week and they checked on him.

social_circle.name: Nikhil Simmons

background.how_they_met: Nikhil is Baljinder and Lauren's son.
background.why_close: Baljinder is an involved father who supports Nikhil's robotics and soccer, leaves notes when he misses bedtime, and tries to stay emotionally present despite shift work.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts like a 12-year-old: short updates, photos, jokes, mild sarcasm, and quick replies. Likely sends memes or one-line commentary rather than long emotional messages.

recent_text_topics: Sending Baljinder pictures or updates when Baljinder works late and misses bedtime.
Robotics schedule changes, soccer gear, and whether Baljinder can make a game.
Sarcastic comments about homework or family calendar reminders.
Photos from school or activities that Lauren forwards or Nikhil sends directly.
Food requests, especially when Baljinder is cooking or meal prepping.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 identifies Nikhil as Baljinder's 12-year-old son who is into robotics, soccer, and sarcastic comments. Q19 says the kids text Baljinder pictures or little updates when he works late, and he leaves notes in their lunchboxes if he will miss bedtime.
